brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: Base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: 3 bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) provide base; bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 is removable bin with 2 compartments for small parts
notch:0#1,1#notch2 stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf installed between bases at 1,1 provides drawer frame; no separate drawer socket offered but notch frame fulfills drawer function per catalog
handle:0,0,0;top on cover:0,0,0;full;top with three inserts

finish.summary: Build has base (3 cells), removable compartmented bin, drawer frame notch, and top handle. check_build ok meshClash clear, only LOOSE_BODY warning and info OPEN_CAP_FACE.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
